---
title: "Bayesian parameter estimation of the algae-rotifer system"
output: html_notebook
---

This is note book provides the R codes for estimating the parameter values in the Lotka-Volterra model
by fitting it to the experimental data.

## Estimating green algae parameters

```{r estimating Cv, Cr,  and Cs mono culture with or without  salt}
library(rstan)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(latex2exp)
library(bayesplot)
library(patchwork)

options(mc.cores = parallel::detectCores())
rstan_options(auto_write = TRUE)


Plot_Logistic_bayes=function(df1, prey, NaCl, gname)
{
  # Read data
  data=df1[df1$Species==prey & df1$NaCl==NaCl, ]

  data$Mean=log10(data$Mean)# log10 transformation
  nSamples = 9 # we have data from time 1 to 9 for each sample
  y0 = data[data$Day==0, ]$Mean #fixed initial condition
  t0 = 0.0
  ts = unique(data[data$Day>0, ]$Day) # time point to evaluate; we omit day 0 becayse it is assume dfixed init condition
  n_samples= 3 #we have three replicate in each condition
  z=t(matrix(data[data$Day>0, ]$Mean, nrow=n_samples))  # data from day 1: column different samples
  # 
  fit= stan(file ="algae_logistic.stan",
                        data = list (
                             T  = nSamples,
                             n_samples = n_samples,
                             y0 = y0[1:n_samples],
                             z  = z[,1:n_samples],
                             t0 = t0,
                             ts = ts),
                         seed = 1,
                         chains = 4,
                         iter = 50000,
                         warmup = 1000
  )
  print(fit, pars=c("theta"), probs=c(.05,.5,.95))
  # few plots
 
  g_r=mcmc_areas(fit,
              pars = c("theta[1]"),
              point_est='median',
              prob = 0.95)+
    ylab('r')+
      theme_classic()+
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 18),
         axis.text.y = element_text(size = 0),
         axis.title.x = element_text(size = '0'),
         axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18),
         legend.position =  "none" ) 
  g_K=mcmc_areas(fit,
              pars = c("theta[2]"),
              point_est='median',
              prob = 0.95)+
    ylab('K')+
      theme_classic()+
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 18),
         axis.text.y = element_text(size = 0),
         axis.title.x = element_text(size = '0'),
         axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18),
         legend.position =  "none" ) 
  
  xdata =data.frame(cells = matrix(z, ncol=1),
                      sample = as.vector(matrix(rep(1:n_samples,nSamples),
                        nrow=nSamples,byrow=TRUE)),time = rep(ts,n_samples))
  pred_df= as.data.frame(fit, pars = "z_pred") %>%
    gather(factor_key = TRUE) %>%
    group_by(key) %>%
    summarize(lb = quantile(value, probs = 0.025),
              median = quantile(value, probs = 0.5),
              ub = quantile(value, probs = 0.975)) %>%
    bind_cols(xdata)
  pred_add=data.frame(key=c('z_pred[0,1]', 'z_pred[0,2]', 'z_pred[0,3]'),
                      lb=y0, median=y0, ub=y0, cells=y0, sample=c(1,2,3), time=0)
  pred_df=rbind(pred_add, pred_df)
  
  
  
  # plot observation data
  g=ggplot(pred_df, aes(x = time, y = cells, color=as.factor(sample)))+geom_point() +
      labs(x = "Time (day)", y = TeX("$\\log_{10}$ Cells (/ml)"))+
    geom_line(aes(x = time, y = median)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lb, ymax = ub), alpha = 0.1)+
    facet_wrap(~factor(sample))+
    theme_classic()+
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 15),
         axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
         axis.title.x = element_text(size = '12'),
         axis.title.y = element_text(size = 15),
         legend.position =  "none" ) 

  
  (g_r+g_K)/g+plot_annotation(tag_levels = 'A')& 
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 24))
  ggsave(gname)
  return(fit)
}
#read data
# test with Cv data without salt
df_prey=read.csv('Prey _2024_Feb.csv') # mono-culture without salt
df_prey$NaCl=0
df_prey_salt=read.csv('Prey _2024_Feb - W__salt.csv') # mono-culture witht salt
df_prey_salt$NaCl=0.06
df1=rbind(df_prey, df_prey_salt)
df1=df1[df1$Day<10, ]#Because some data lack at day 10, we only use data until day 9

cv_control=Plot_Logistic_bayes(df1, prey='C. vulgaris', 0, "PreyDynamics_Cv0M_bayes.png") # Cv without salt
cv_salt=Plot_Logistic_bayes(df1, prey='C. vulgaris', 0.06, "PreyDynamics_Cv006M_bayes.png") # Cv with salt
cs_control=Plot_Logistic_bayes(df1, prey='C.sphaeroides', 0., "PreyDynamics_Cs0M_bayes.png") # Cs without salt
cs_salt=Plot_Logistic_bayes(df1, prey='C.sphaeroides', 0.06, "PreyDynamics_Cs006M_bayes.png") # Cs without salt
```


## Estimating rotifers' mortality
```{r Cv and rotifer without salt}
library(deSolve)
LV=function(t, x, parm){
  with(as.list(c(x, parm)),{
    dx1=r*x1*(1-x1/K)-a*x1*x2
    dx2=x2*(b*a*x1-m)
   return(list(c(dx1, dx2)))
  })
}



# make it function below
Prey_Predator_bayse1=function(df, prey, NaCl, algae_posterior, 
                              fname, init_stan_file=0, priors=NaN)
{
  data=df[df$Prey==prey & df$NaCl==NaCl, ]
  data$Predator.count=log10(data$Predator.count+1) # log transformation. Add one to avoid log 0
  data$Algae.Mean=log10(data$Algae.Mean) # log transformation
  
  # get posterior distributions of algae parameters
  posterior_samples = rstan::extract(algae_posterior)
  r_samples = posterior_samples$theta[,1] # we use the median value
  K_samples = posterior_samples$theta[,2] # we use the median value
  
  #prepare the parameter estimation
  ts = unique(data[data$Day > 0, ]$Day) # time point to evaluate
  samples = unique(data$Sample)
  
  for(i in 1:length(samples)){
    prey0 = data[data$Day == 0& data$Sample==samples[i], ]$Algae.Mean  # init algae density
    pred0 = data[data$Day == 0& data$Sample==samples[i], ]$Predator.count# init rotifer density
    y0=c(prey0, pred0)
    t0 = 0.0
    prey_obs = data[data$Day > 0 & data$Sample==samples[i], ]$Algae.Mean
    pred_obs = data[data$Day > 0 & data$Sample==samples[i], ]$Predator.count
    #print(i)
    if(i==1){
      if(init_stan_file==0){
         #  Perform stan
        fit = stan(
            file = "prey_predator.stan",
            data = list(
              T = length(ts), # total time point to observe
              y0=y0, # initial condition
              y= matrix(c(prey_obs,pred_obs), ncol=2), # observation
              t0 = t0, # init time
              ts = ts, # time points to observe
              r = median(r_samples),
              K = median(K_samples),
              c = 1 # fixed parameter. arbitrary value to avoid the multicolinearity.
            ),
          seed = 1,
          chains = 4,
          iter = 50000,
          warmup = 1000,
          )
      }else{
         # use the posterior distribution of attack rate (without salt) as prior
       # a_samples=rstan::extract(cv_pred_0M)$theta[,1]
        a_samples=rstan::extract(priors)$theta[,1]
          fit = stan(
          file = "prey_predator2.stan",
          data = list(
            T = length(ts), 
            y0=y0, 
            y= matrix(c(prey_obs,pred_obs), ncol=2), 
            t0 = t0, 
            ts = ts, 
            r = median(r_samples),
            K = median(K_samples),
            c = 1, # fixed parameter. arbitrary value to avoid the multicolinearity.
            mean_a=mean(a_samples),
            sd_a=sd(a_samples)
          ),
          seed = 1,
          chains = 4,
          iter = 50000,
          warmup = 1000,
    )
        }
      }
    else
      {
        posterior_samples=rstan::extract(fit)
        fit = stan(
        file = "prey_predator_revewal.stan", # use different stan file to update posterior distribution
        data = list(
          T = length(ts), 
          y0=y0, 
          y= matrix(c(prey_obs,pred_obs), ncol=2), 
          t0 = t0, 
          ts = ts, 
          r = median(r_samples),
          K = median(K_samples),
          c =1, 
          a_mean = mean(posterior_samples$theta[,1]),
          a_sd = sd(posterior_samples$theta[,1]),
          m_mean = mean(posterior_samples$theta[,2]),
          m_sd = sd(posterior_samples$theta[,2]),
          sigma1_mean = mean(posterior_samples$sigma[,1]),
          sigma1_sd = sd(posterior_samples$sigma[,1]),
          sigma2_mean = mean(posterior_samples$sigma[,2]),
          sigma2_sd = sd(posterior_samples$sigma[,2])
        ),
        seed = 1,
        chains = 4,
        iter = 50000,
        warmup =1000,
        )
      }
  }
  # Posterior check
  cv_pred_0M=fit
  g_a=mcmc_areas(fit,point_est='median',
                pars = c("theta[1]"),
                prob = 0.95)+
  ylab('a')+
      theme_classic()+
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
         axis.text.y = element_text(size = 0),
         axis.title.x = element_text(size = 0),
         axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18),
         legend.position =  "none" ) 
  g_m=mcmc_areas(fit,point_est='median',
                pars = c("theta[2]"),
                prob = 0.95)+
    ylab('m')+
      theme_classic()+
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
         axis.text.y = element_text(size = 0),
         axis.title.x = element_text(size = 0),
         axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18),
         legend.position =  "none" ) 
  


  #Posterior sampling
  sample_n=1000
  posterior_samples=rstan::extract(cv_pred_0M)
  a_sample= sample(posterior_samples$theta[,1], sample_n)
  m_sample= sample(posterior_samples$theta[,2], sample_n)
  init=c(x1=mean(data[data$Day == 0, ]$Algae.Mean),
         x2=mean(data[data$Day == 0, ]$Predator.count)
  )
  #Posterior sampling
  for(i in 1:sample_n){
    out=ode(y=init,times=unique(data$Day),func=LV,
              parm=list(r=median(r_samples), K=median(K_samples), 
                        a=a_sample[i], b=1,  m=m_sample[i]))
    outdf_add=data.frame(out)
    outdf_add$Sample=sprintf('Simulation%d',i)
    if (i==1){
       outdf=outdf_add
    }else{
      outdf=rbind(outdf, outdf_add)
    }
  }
  df_exp=data.frame(time=data$Day, x1=data$Algae.Mean, 
                    x2=data$Predator.count, Sample=data$Sample)
  g1=ggplot(df_exp, aes(x=time, y=x1, color=Sample))+geom_line()+geom_point(size=2)+
    xlab('Time (day)')+ylab(TeX(' $\\log_{10}$ Cells (/ml)'))+
    scale_x_continuous(breaks=c(0,3,6,9))+
    theme_classic()+
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
          axis.title.x = element_text(size = 18),
          axis.title.y = element_text(size=18),
          legend.position= 'none')+
    geom_line(data=outdf, aes(x=time, y=x1,group=Sample), alpha=0.011, color='grey')
  g2=ggplot(df_exp, aes(x=time, y=x2, color=Sample))+geom_line()+geom_point(size=2)+
    xlab('Time (day)')+ylab(TeX(' $\\log_{10}$(Rotifers $+1$)  (/ml)'))+
    scale_x_continuous(breaks=c(0,3,6,9))+
    theme_classic()+
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
          axis.title.x = element_text(size = 18),
          axis.title.y = element_text(size=18),
          legend.position= 'none')+
    geom_line(data=outdf, aes(x=time, y=x2,group=Sample), alpha=0.01, color='grey')
    
  g=g_a+g_m+g1+g2+plot_layout(ncol = 2)+plot_annotation(tag_levels = 'A')& 
    theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 24))
  ggsave(fname)
  return(fit)
}
df=read.csv('Prey_predator_experiment.csv')
cv_predator_0M=Prey_Predator_bayse1(df,'C. vulgaris',  0, 
                                    cv_control, 'Cv_prey-predator_0M.png')
```

```{r Cv and rotifer with salt}
cv_predator_006M=Prey_Predator_bayse1(df,'C. vulgaris',  0.06, 
                                    cv_control, 'Cv_prey-predator_006M.png',
                                    1, cv_predator_0M)
```

```{r Comparison of the mortality of rotifers}
df_diff=data.frame(a_cv=(rstan::extract(cv_predator_0M)$theta[,1]- rstan::extract(cv_predator_006M)$theta[,1])/rstan::extract(cv_predator_006M)$theta[,1],
                  m_cv=(rstan::extract(cv_predator_0M)$theta[,2]- rstan::extract(cv_predator_006M)$theta[,2])/ rstan::extract(cv_predator_006M)$theta[,2]
                   )
a_density=density(df_diff$a_cv)
m_density=density(df_diff$m_cv)

density_a_df=data.frame(x=a_density$x, y=a_density$y)
density_m_df=data.frame(x=m_density$x, y=m_density$y)

lower_a = quantile(df_diff$a_cv, 0.025)
median_a = quantile(df_diff$a_cv, 0.5)
upper_a = quantile(df_diff$a_cv, 0.975)
lower_m = quantile(df_diff$m_cv, 0.025)
median_m = quantile(df_diff$m_cv, 0.5)
upper_m = quantile(df_diff$m_cv, 0.975)
g1=ggplot(density_a_df, aes(x=x, y=y))+
   geom_area(fill='white')+
  geom_area(data=subset(density_a_df, x>=lower_a & x<=upper_a), fill='skyblue')+
  geom_line(color='black')+
  geom_vline(xintercept=0, linetype='dashed')+
  xlab(TeX("$(a_{1 1}-a_{1 2})/a_{1 2}$"))+
  ylab("Density")+
   annotate("text", x=lower_a,   y=3, size=8, label=round(lower_a,2)) +
  annotate("text", x=upper_a, y=3, size=8, label=round(upper_a, 2))+
  annotate("text", x=median_a, y=15, size=8, label=round(median_a, 2))+
  theme_classic()+
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
         axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
         axis.title.x = element_text(size = 18),
         axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18),
         legend.position =  "none" ) 
g2=ggplot(density_m_df, aes(x=x, y=y))+
   geom_area(fill='white')+
  geom_area(data=subset(density_m_df, x>=lower_m & x<=upper_m), fill='skyblue')+
  geom_line(color='black')+
  geom_vline(xintercept=0, linetype='dashed')+
   xlab(TeX("$(m_{1}-m_{2})/m_{2}$"))+
  ylab("Density")+
  annotate("text", x=lower_m,   y=2, size=8, label=round(lower_m,2)) +
  annotate("text", x=upper_m, y=2, size=8, label=round(upper_m, 2))+
  annotate("text", x=median_m, y=6, size=8, label=round(median_m, 2))+
  theme_classic()+
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
         axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
         axis.title.x = element_text(size = 18),
         axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18),
         legend.position =  "none" ) 

g=g1/g2+plot_annotation(tag_levels = 'A')& 
    theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 24))
  ggsave('Rotifer_mortality_diff.png')
```

## Estimating attack rates on Cv

```{r  Cs and rotifer without salts}
library(deSolve)
LV=function(t, x, parm){
  with(as.list(c(x, parm)),{
    dx1=r*x1*(1-x1/K)-a*x1*x2
    dx2=x2*(c*a*x1-m)
   return(list(c(dx1, dx2)))
  })
}



# make it function below
Prey_Predator_bayse2=function(df, prey, NaCl, 
                              algae_posterior, m_samples,
                              fname, init_stan_file=0, priors=NaN){
  data=df[df$Prey==prey & df$NaCl==NaCl, ]
  data$Predator.count=log10(data$Predator.count+1) # log transformation. Add one to avoid log 0
  data$Algae.Mean=log10(data$Algae.Mean) # log transformation
  
  # get posterior distributions of algae parameters
  posterior_samples = rstan::extract(algae_posterior)
  r_samples = posterior_samples$theta[,1] # we use the median value
  K_samples = posterior_samples$theta[,2] # we use the median value
  #prepare the parameter estimation
  ts = unique(data[data$Day > 0, ]$Day) # time point to evaluate
  samples = unique(data$Sample)
  
  for(i in 1:length(samples)){
    prey0 = data[data$Day == 0& data$Sample==samples[i], ]$Algae.Mean  # init algae density
    pred0 = data[data$Day == 0& data$Sample==samples[i], ]$Predator.count# init rotifer density
    y0=c(prey0, pred0)
    t0 = 0.0
    prey_obs = data[data$Day > 0 & data$Sample==samples[i], ]$Algae.Mean
    pred_obs = data[data$Day > 0 & data$Sample==samples[i], ]$Predator.count
    #print(i)
     if(i==1){
    # Stan
      if(init_stan_file==0){
         fit = stan(
        file = "prey_predator_fixed_m.stan",
        data = list(
          T = length(ts), 
          y0=y0, 
          y= matrix(c(prey_obs,pred_obs), ncol=2), 
          t0 = t0, 
          ts = ts,
          r = median(r_samples),
          K = median(K_samples),
          m = median(m_samples)
        ),
        seed = 1,
        chains = 4,
        iter =50000,
        warmup = 1000,
      )
      }else if(init_stan_file==1){
         fit = stan(
      file = "prey_predator_fixed_m_c.stan",
      data = list(
        T = length(ts), #
        y0=y0, # 
        y= matrix(c(prey_obs,pred_obs), ncol=2), # 
        t0 = t0, 
        ts = ts,
        r = median(r_samples),
        K = median(K_samples),
        m = median(m_samples),
      　mean_c = mean(rstan::extract(priors)$theta[,2]),
        sd_c = sd(rstan::extract(priors)$theta[,2])
      ),
      seed = 1,
      chains = 4,
      iter = 50000,
      warmup = 1000,
    )
      }else{
        fit = stan(
      file = "prey_predator_fixed_m_c_a.stan",
      data = list(
        T = length(ts), #
        y0=y0, # 
        y= matrix(c(prey_obs,pred_obs), ncol=2), # 
        t0 = t0, 
        ts = ts,
        r = median(r_samples),
        K = median(K_samples),
        m = median(m_samples),
      　mean_c = mean(rstan::extract(priors)$theta[,2]),
        sd_c = sd(rstan::extract(priors)$theta[,2]),
      　mean_a = mean(rstan::extract(priors)$theta[,1]),
        sd_a = sd(rstan::extract(priors)$theta[,1])
      ),
      seed = 1,
      chains = 4,
      iter = 50000,
      warmup = 1000,
    )
      }
     
    }
  else
  {
    posterior_samples=rstan::extract(fit)
    fit = stan(
    file = "prey_predator_fixed_m_renewal.stan",
    data = list(
      T = length(ts), 
      y0=y0, 
      y= matrix(c(prey_obs,pred_obs), ncol=2), 
      t0 = t0, 
      ts = ts, 
      r = median(r_samples),
      K = median(K_samples),
      m =median(m_samples), 
      a_mean = mean(posterior_samples$theta[,1]),
      a_sd = sd(posterior_samples$theta[,1]),
      c_mean= mean(posterior_samples$theta[,2]),
      c_sd= sd(posterior_samples$theta[,2]),
      sigma1_mean = mean(posterior_samples$sigma[,1]),
      sigma1_sd = sd(posterior_samples$sigma[,1]),
      sigma2_mean = mean(posterior_samples$sigma[,2]),
      sigma2_sd = sd(posterior_samples$sigma[,2])
    ),
    seed = 1,
    chains = 4,
    iter = 50000,
    warmup =1000,
    )
  }
  # Posterior check
  cs_pred_0M=fit
  g_a=mcmc_areas(fit,point_est='median',
                pars = c("theta[1]"),
                prob = 0.95)+
  ylab('a')+
      theme_classic()+
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
         axis.text.y = element_text(size = 0),
         axis.title.x = element_text(size = 0),
         axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18),
         legend.position =  "none" ) 
  g_c=mcmc_areas(fit,point_est='median',
                pars = c("theta[2]"),
                prob = 0.95)+
  ylab('c')+
      theme_classic()+
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
         axis.text.y = element_text(size = 0),
         axis.title.x = element_text(size = 0),
         axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18),
         legend.position =  "none" ) 
 
  
  #Posterior sampling
  sample_n=1000
  posterior_samples=rstan::extract(cs_pred_0M)
  a_sample= sample(posterior_samples$theta[,1], sample_n)
  c_sample= sample(posterior_samples$theta[,2], sample_n)
  init=c(x1=mean(data[data$Day == 0, ]$Algae.Mean),
         x2=mean(data[data$Day == 0, ]$Predator.count)
  )
  #Posterior sampling
  for(i in 1:sample_n){
    out=ode(y=init,times=unique(data$Day),func=LV,
              parm=list(r=median(r_samples), K=median(K_samples),  
                        m =median(m_samples),
                        a=a_sample[i],   c=c_sample[i]
                    ))
    outdf_add=data.frame(out)
    outdf_add$Sample=sprintf('Simulation%d',i)
    if (i==1){
       outdf=outdf_add
    }else{
      outdf=rbind(outdf, outdf_add)
    }
  }
  df_exp=data.frame(time=data$Day, x1=data$Algae.Mean, 
                    x2=data$Predator.count, Sample=data$Sample)
  g1=ggplot(df_exp, aes(x=time, y=x1, color=Sample))+geom_line()+geom_point(size=2)+
    xlab('Time (day)')+ylab(TeX(' $\\log_{10}$ Cells (/ml)'))+
    scale_x_continuous(breaks=c(0,3,6,9))+
    theme_classic()+
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
          axis.title.x = element_text(size = 18),
          axis.title.y = element_text(size=18),
          legend.position= 'none')+
    geom_line(data=outdf, aes(x=time, y=x1,group=Sample), alpha=0.011, color='grey')
  g2=ggplot(df_exp, aes(x=time, y=x2, color=Sample))+geom_line()+geom_point(size=2)+
    xlab('Time (day)')+ylab(TeX(' $\\log_{10}$(Rotifers $+1$)  (/ml)'))+
    scale_x_continuous(breaks=c(0,3,6,9))+
    theme_classic()+
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
          axis.title.x = element_text(size = 18),
          axis.title.y = element_text(size=18),
          legend.position= 'none')+
    geom_line(data=outdf, aes(x=time, y=x2,group=Sample), alpha=0.01, color='grey')
    
  g=g_a+g_c+g1+g2+plot_layout(ncol = 2)+plot_annotation(tag_levels = 'A')& 
    theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 24))
  ggsave(fname)
  return(fit)
  }
}
df=read.csv('Prey_predator_experiment.csv')
cs_predator_0M=Prey_Predator_bayse2(df,'C.sphaeroides',  0, 
                                    cs_control, rstan::extract(cv_predator_0M)$theta[,2],
                                    'Cs_prey-predator_0M.png',
                                    0)
```

```{r Comparison of the attack rates on cs}
g2=ggplot(density_m_df, aes(x=x, y=y))+

scientific_notation <- function(x) {
     x <- format(x, scientific = TRUE)
     x <- gsub("^(.*)e", "'\\1'e", x)
     x <- gsub("e", "%*%10^", x)
     x <- gsub('\\+', '', x)
     parse(text = x)
}
```
